_: The slayer headgear: the black mask, the slayer helmet, and every recoloured variant, each in a
plain and an imbued form. tools/genslayerhelm.py turns this into the coloured helmets' objs, the
recolour interaction and the unlock purchases.
IT IS A GENERATOR BECAUSE THE LIST ONLY GROWS. Two colours is four near-identical objs today;
the black one arrives with the King Black Dragon in batch 3 and OSRS has eight more after that.
Six configs differing in two lines each is exactly the shape that drifts.
MEMBERSHIP IS THREE PARAMS, NOT A LIST OF NAMES. slayer_headgear is anything that gives the
on-task melee bonus (the masks and every helmet), slayer_helmet is the four protections a helmet
inherits from its parts (helmets only - a bare mask has no earmuffs), and slayer_imbued is the
ranged and magic boost. Adding a colour then needs no edit to any proc: the item declares what
it is and the three doors read that. A category would have been simpler still, but an obj gets
only one and these are already armour_helmet, which the Entrana monk and the desert heat read.
THE RECOLOUR IS CONFIG-LEVEL. The helmet's mask is the same two colours the black mask itself
uses - rgb15 3170 and 5284 - so a variant is two recol pairs and needs no new model. The
destination values were found by searching the reachable rgb15 space for the nearest paint to a
target, and rendered before being written down.
UNLOCK BITS 5 and 6 in %slayer_unlocks. 0-4 are Gargoyle Smasher, Slug Salter, Reptile
Freezer, Ring Bling and Bigger and Badder; these are the next two free.
